Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Champagne and Gold. Quantity: 62 pack.
Shatter resistant plastic construction provides a safe alternative to traditional glass ornaments for festive decorating.
Features intricate pine cone and snowflake detailing with a glitter finish for added texture and visual interest on the tree.
Reusable design ensures long-lasting durability, allowing these champagne and gold baubles to be stored and enjoyed year after year.
Comes in a convenient 62 pack, offering ample quantity to fully decorate your Christmas tree or coordinate multiple displays.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: 62 Christmas baubles
Hanger included

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. Dimensions: 65 x 65 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.

5056797097711.sourceDescription:
Add warmth and elegance to your entrance with this illuminated metal wreath from MySmartBuy. Its metal wreath frame is lit with warm white micro LEDs for a soft, sparkling glow that gives a classic Christmas welcome with a modern twist. It is available in 25cm with 800 LEDs or 35cm with 900 LEDs, so you can choose a compact wreath for a door or window or a slightly larger one for a wall or gate. It makes a lovely outdoor display on front doors, entrances and garden walls. It is supplied with a 3m lead cable and BS IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket. A lit wreath is the perfect finishing touch for the front of the house, giving visitors a warm welcome and making your home look instantly festive from the street. Pair it with matching lights along the porch or a garland around the door frame for a coordinated look. A beautiful way to welcome guests this Christmas, it can be brought out year after year to make your home look instantly festive. At a glance: metal wreath | warm white micro LEDs | 25cm (800 LEDs) or 35cm (900 LEDs) | 3m lead cable | BS IP20 transformer | outdoor use.

CLASSIC WITH A MODERN TWIST : A traditional festive shape with the crisp sparkle of micro LEDs.

5056797099111.sourceDescription:
Bring a classic Christmas scene to your front garden with this gold rattan reindeer and sleigh set from MySmartBuy. One reindeer leaps forward while the other stands proud, both with tall branching antlers and festive collars of greenery with red berries, leading an elegant sleigh with curling scroll runners, trimmed with foliage and a bright red bow. Crafted from PVC rattan with glitter accents, the set is lit with 60 warm white LEDs, including 12 flashing lights that add a gentle twinkle. After dark, the warm golden glow looks wonderful on a frosty lawn or beside the front door, and by day the natural rattan look keeps your display looking festive. Ground spikes are included to hold each piece securely on lawns, in borders and beside pathways. The set is supplied with a 5m lead cable for plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening. Also available in silver glitter, this set pairs beautifully with light up trees, wreaths and garlands to create a warm, traditional Christmas display that the whole street will enjoy. At a glance: 2 reindeer and sleigh | gold PVC rattan with glitter accents | foliage collars and red bow details | 60 warm white LEDs including 12 flashing | ground spikes included | 5m lead cable | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer.

Balloons will arrive uninflated and will need to be inflated using air (reusable inflation tube to blow through included).
Simply insert the reusable inflation tube into the plastic valve at the bottom of the number and slowly blow to inflate. After the party, please use a plastic reusable inflation tube to export the air for reuse

Decorate your house with this Christmas flying reindeer and sleigh decoration. Made of acrylic, this Xmas decoration appears a cool and icy look. The glowing reindeer and sleigh decoration features 72 LED lights, which are energy-efficient and long-lasting. Designed with 8 different lighting effects: a combination of all the effects, slow-glow, twinkle/flash, in wave, chasing/running water, sequential, steady on and slow fade, it beautifully lights up and creates a magical holiday atmosphere. Additionally, the included stand adds to its stableness. Note: The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. The included USB is not waterproof so this part has to avoid the water, but thanks to the 5m cable the reindeers & sleighs can be used outdoors as the cable and product are waterproof.
Manufacturer guarantee : 1 month
